meta_title: E Dugdale Sons & Grandsons | Central Heating Blackpool
meta_description: E Dugdale Sons & Grandsons specialises in central heating installation, repair and maintenance across Blackpool. Family business with 30+ years experience. Call today.
hero_subhead: Reliable boiler repairs, system upgrades and emergency callouts. Same-day service across Blackpool and Thornton-Cleveleys.
services_heading: Complete Central Heating Services in Blackpool
services_subhead: From routine annual checks to full system replacement, we handle every aspect of your home heating.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Expert fitting of new high-efficiency boilers with 10-year manufacturer warranty. We remove and dispose of your old unit and test the entire system for safety.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of faults — most issues fixed same day. Annual servicing keeps your boiler running efficiently and maintains your warranty.

services.title: Central Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Replace aging radiators, pipework and controls. Modern systems cut heating bills by up to 30% and offer better temperature control throughout your home.

services.title: Emergency Heating Callouts
services.desc: No heat in winter? We're on call around the clock. Our engineers aim to reach you within 60 minutes with parts and tools ready to restore warmth.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Add new radiators to any room or replace damaged units. We balance your system to ensure even heat distribution and maximum comfort.

services.title: Power Flush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Clear sludge and debris from your heating circuit. A power flush restores flow, improves efficiency and extends the life of your boiler and radiators.

about_pullquote: Three generations of heating engineers doing it right for our neighbours.
about_para_1: E Dugdale, Sons & Grandsons has been keeping Blackpool homes warm for over 30 years. What started as a father-and-son operation has grown into a family-run team that knows the local area inside out. Every engineer carries the same commitment to honest pricing and quality work that built our reputation in the first place.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on showing up when we say we will, diagnosing problems fairly, and never recommending work you don't actually need. Most of our customers come back to us year after year for their annual service or when they're ready to upgrade. That loyalty means everything to us.
reviews_heading: What Blackpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had to get my boiler fixed just before Christmas. Called E Dugdale on a Friday afternoon and they got an engineer to me the next morning. Fixed a broken pump in under two hours. Brilliant service and honest price. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Malcolm T.

reviews.text: Replaced our old heating system last summer. The lads explained everything clearly, did a tidy job and cleaned up after themselves. My bills have come down noticeably and the heat distribution is much better now. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: Annual service on the boiler. No faffing about, proper engineers who know their stuff. They spotted a potential issue with a valve and sorted it before it became a problem. That's exactly the kind of foresight you want from a heating company.
reviews.author: David H.
